g.text: 2) Users should be able to view a given problem and code a solution

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: - To view a problem, the client will make a request to the API server with GET /problems/:id and the server will

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: return the full problem statement and code stub after fetching it from the database.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: 3) Users should be able to submit their solution and get instant feedback

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: Bad Sol: Running code in api server

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: - User can submit malicious code, or code which has memory leaks, running Code is cpu intensive, it can bring down your

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: server and with other no othe request to be processed.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: Good Sol: Running Code in Virtual Machine (VM)

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: - VMs are resource intensive, can be slow to start up.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: - Need to ensure we are not running out of resources / leaving VMs running when not needed.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: Great Sol: Run Code inside a Container

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: - Containers, on the other hand, share the host system's kernel and isolate the application processes from each other.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: They include the application and its dependencies (libraries, binaries) but not a full OS, making them lightweight and enabling faster start times

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: - We can create container for each runtime we support and run code in a sandboxed environment.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: Challenge: Properly configure and secure container to prevent users from breaking out of container & accessing the host system.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: Great Sol: Run Code in Serverless Function

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: - Serverless Function (AWS) : Serverless functions are small, stateless, event-driven functions that run in response to triggers (e.g. an HTTP request).

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: They are managed by a cloud provider and automatically scale up or down based on demand, making them a great option for

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: running code that is CPU intensive or unpredictable in terms of load.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: - Serverless functions have a cold start time, which can introduce latency for the first request to a function.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: Additionally, serverless functions have resource limits that can impact the performance of long running or resource intensive code

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: - query the submission table for all items/rows with the competitionId and then group by userId, ordering by the number of distinct problems solved

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: (since a user might submit multiple passing solutions for the same problem).

g.text: - NoSQL DB like DynamoDB, you could create a Global Secondary Index (GSI) with competitionId as the partition key

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: - The client will request the leaderboard again after 5 seconds so ensure it is up to date.

g.text: 1) How will the system support isolation and security when running user code?

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: To prevent users from writing to the filesystem, we can mount the code directory as read-only and write any output

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: to a temporary directory that is deleted a short time after completion

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: To prevent users from running infinite loops, we can wrap the user's code in a timeout that kills the process if it runs

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: for longer than a predefined time limit, say 5 seconds

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: 4) Limit Network Access : Can use AWS vpcs security group and nacls to restrict al outbound and inboun traffic except essential conenction

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: 5) No System Calls (Seccomp): We don't want users to be able to make system calls that could compromise the host system

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: 2) How would you make fetching the leaderboard more efficient?

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: - Redis sorted set with periodic polling

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: - Real-time leaderboard using Redis sorted sets, with submission results persisted separately in the main

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: - On each submission, write to the DB and ZADD competition:leaderboard:{competitionId} {score} {userId}. -

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: - Clients poll GET /competitions/:competitionId/leaderboard?top=100 every 5 seconds; the server serves

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: ZRANGE competition:leaderboard:{competitionId} 0 N-1 REV WITHSCORES — no DB queries needed.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: - Initial load sends the top ~1,000 entries; further pages are fetched on demand as the user scrolls/paginates.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: - Sorted sets keep members ordered by score with O(log N) updates and fast range queries, making top-N

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: retrieval and ranking cheap even under frequent writes.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: - Simpler than WebSockets, near-real-time (5s is fine for this use case), minimal DB load, and scales comfortably

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: polling interval can be tuned further if needed.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: 3) How would the system scale to support competitions with 100,000 users?

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: We can horizontally scale each of the language specific containers to handle more submissions

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: - Great Sol: Horizontal Scaling w/ Queue

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: - Allow us to buffer submissions during peak times and ensure that we don't overwhelm the containers.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: - We can use a managed queue service like SQS to handle this for us.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: - Introduction of the queue has made the system asynchronous.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: This means that the API server will no longer be able to return the results of the submission immediately.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: - Instead, the user will need to poll the server for the results. We introduce a new endpoint, say

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: GET /check/:id, that is polled every second by the client to check if the submission has been processed.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: It simply looks up the submission in the database and returns the results if they are available

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: - Having that buffer could help you sleep at night knowing you're not going to lose any submissions,

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: even in the event of a sudden spike in traffic, retry if container fails.
